persona.label: ZM — own zone
persona.frequency: all day, every day, first screen on login

goals: Triage Action Required items same-day (unreviewed batches, VURs, readiness conflicts, failed verification, component-blocked, WAITING_COMPONENT 7d+, non-op confirmations, manual-assignment escalations)
Read zone health at a glance and spot deterioration (Zone Overview + Company/Plant drill-down, SLA bucket split, trend vs yesterday)
Act on the worst devices without hunting (Grouped Critical Work Queue, suggested SE, one-click assign)
scopeNote: PRD page-inventory (:321) names dashboard as 3 things (Action Required, Zone/Company tables, Grouped Critical Work Queue); Flow 1 (:347-478) adds snapshot banner + implies trend/SLA-distribution visuals not in the inventory row. Action Required cards are triage entry points into other modules (Schedules, Intraday, Component-Blocked, Non-Op) — dashboard's job is surfacing + one-click routing, not owning those workflows. Recorded, not resolved.

capabilities.name: Action Required panel (8 card types, urgency-ordered)
capabilities.why: without it, failed verification / component-blocked / 7d-waiting items sit buried in lists, ZM misses same-day escalations

capabilities.name: Zone Overview table (SLA bucket split, trend% vs yesterday)
capabilities.why: ZM's core deteriorating-zone read; without it can't prioritize which zone to work first

capabilities.name: Company/Plant Overview drill-down (company to plant to device)
capabilities.why: without it ZM can't identify which customer accounts are at SLA-breach risk

capabilities.name: Grouped Critical Work Queue (CRITICAL+ by company/plant, suggested SE, one-click assign)
capabilities.why: without it worst-bucket devices need manual per-ticket routing, delays the highest-severity work

capabilities.name: Snapshot data-as-of freshness banner (all panels)
capabilities.why: without it ZM acts on stale device data unknowingly; CONTEXT.md: FAILED/stuck Snapshot means inactive devices may not surface in time for dispatch

capabilities.name: Zone operating-mode (DEFICIT/PREVENTIVE) + reason, plain language
capabilities.why: without it ZM can't tell why the Recommender is prioritizing devices-cleared vs repeat-offenders, can't sanity-check dispatched batches (CONTEXT.md:195-196)

capabilities.name: Fleet activity trend chart (inactive/troubleshoot/install, 1D-MAX)
capabilities.why: visual trend context; absence is a downgrade not a stoppage, tabular Zone Overview trend% already carries the signal

capabilities.name: Excel export (Zone Overview, Company/Plant Overview)
capabilities.why: without it ZM can't share zone status in operations calls

capabilities.name: Role-scoped lens: ZM own-zone vs CSM cross-zone+acting-scope vs OH fleet-wide read
capabilities.why: one dashboard shown identically to all three breaks CSM's acting-zone context and OH's fleet aggregate need — taxonomy C6 'role has no lens' risk
